exceptions.reason: `Tooltip.test.ts` tests the group through `Tooltip.Provider`: the delay of the group, `timeout`, one open tooltip at a time, `data-instant`, the tooltips with no provider, a tooltip that unmounts (VUE-48) and the props of the provider at their use. A tooltip reads the group at an event, so the group renders no tooltip.

relocations.behavior: The group of tooltips: one open at a time, and an open at once while the group is active.
